verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a Muted item status, which gives a basic mute mechanism for noisy items. Its grouping, custom fingerprinting, and item merging also reduce duplicate items, which indirectly cuts alert noise. Nothing in the pack documents spike protection or per-key/per-token rate limits, so only one of the three named controls is evidenced. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-key rate limits, documented ignore/mute rule configuration tied to notifications, independent corroboration.
